text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak says that the collapse of the peace process will not lead to war but it will open the door to terrorist operations. Mubarak says in the interview with the American television station PBS that it is not possible to put pressure on Palestinian President Yasser Arafat to accept things (concerning the Middle East peace talks) that the Palestinian people themselves would not accept.
- Inflation shrinks to 5.7 percent at the end of November.
- Mubarak and Jordan's King Hussein meet in Aswan today for talks on the latest developments in the peace process.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri meets Saudi businessmen and says that the investment facilities found in Egypt make it one of the most attractive places to invest.
- Toshka is ready to receive Mubarak, who within hours will announce the birth of the project in the south Delta.
- Five people from one family were killed when the roof of their apartment collapsed.
- Egyptian triplets are named Salam, Hosni and Mubarak.
